test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 17 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Steel Authority of Indian Limited is an example of:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Public sector industry**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Steel Authority of India Limited (SAIL)** is an example of a public sector industry.
 
• SAIL is one of the largest steel-making companies in India and one of the Maharatnas of the country's Central Public Sector Enterprises.
 
• It operates and owns five integrated steel plants, three special steel plants, and one subsidiary in different parts of India.
 
• The Government of India owns about 75% of SAIL's equity, making it a public sector undertaking.
 
• Public sector industries are those that are owned, managed, and controlled by the government.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Public sector enterprises play a crucial role in the economic development of a country.
 
• They are established to achieve various socio-economic objectives like providing employment, reducing income inequalities, and ensuring balanced regional development.
 
• Some other examples of public sector industries in India include Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited (BHEL), Oil and Natural Gas Corporation (ONGC), and Indian Oil Corporation Limited (IOCL).
